drafts.draft_en:
Greatest unlock for any marketing team shipping AI creative: an agent checks every ad against your brand rules, the claims legal signed off on, and each platform's policy before it goes live.

It approves it, tells you the fix, or blocks it.

You just read the verdict and hit publish.

That's what we're building at Aubric.
